verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt file, the export CLI and the search deep links are adjacent features and do not let an agent connect via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
